messages:
Zara: Thinking about a tiny potluck in Dolores Park Saturday afternoon? I can bring spanakopita and a blanket. anyone else free? :fork_and_knife_with_plate:
Omar: I'm in if there are dogs. will bring hummus + pita. dog emoji or i don't come :dog2:
Nina: Ive got a small loaf of sourdough and some sliced pear. can also bring a frisbee.
Zara: perfect. i'm planning to set up near the playground around 3pm so it's sunny but not too hot.
Omar: heads up: i may be 10-15 late, double booked with a haircut appointment :haircut_man:
Nina: that's fine. also curious if anyone will bring wine? i can bring sparkling water if not.
Zara: no alcohol in the park rules, remember? but picnics happen. disease of rules. bringing iced tea instead.
ops-bot: Reminder: Park permit not required for groups under 25. Please follow local ordinances and clean up after yourselves.
Omar: noted. will bring trash bags and some reusable utensils.
Nina: i'll bring some napkins and hand sanitizer.
Zara: also quick shoutout: big thanks to @Nina for the plant cuttings she shared at last week's desk swap 60a
Nina: yay :blush: glad they found new homes!
Omar: can anyone bring an extra folding chair? my camping one is tiny.
Zara: i have one foldable stool, but it's low. pm me if you need it.
Nina: vote check: picnic + games at 3pm? reply with "yes" or "pass"
Omar: yes
Nina: yes
Zara: yes
Zara: Final: picnic at Dolores Park, near playground at 3pm. bring snacks, water, sun hat. i'll post a short message with a photo of where we'll be once i'm set up. see y'all! :sunny:
